summary: Every flag from the merge notes was read. Settled: the pale mass at the field's corner is a rock (the hooded figure is dropped); the shapes at the man at the post are his own sleeve and forearm (no second figure, nothing hung on the bar); the field holds 13 trunk feet, t1's trees, plus a faint fourteenth; far_tree_30985 is a far shrub, not the far willow's twig ends; the hut willow is one leaning tree (reading a), and the willows pass's base is right; the slats over the counter are the shed's lattice. Not settled (no change): the five far figures and the far ox, the blob at 29300, the stall man's third head. Four new entities, all low: a fourteenth young tree (29968), a small far tree at the top edge both tiles left to each other (30297), the banked far fields above the chase field with their diagonal edge (30400), and a far slope stroke under the far shrubs (30950). Thirteen changes: five far field lines added to S1.grd.terraced_fields_29450, two extended and two moved onto their strokes (8-17 px); young_bare_29655's foot moved 60 px down to the drawn foot; field_30430's ridge line lowered 8-14 px east of 30370; and notes settled on the field, the rock, the man at the post, the post, the hut willow, far_tree_30985, the twin willow, the far willow at 30500, young_bare_29948 and the stall shed. No figure, animal or bird lacks an entity in u 29050-31100.

lessons: **Check far field lines with line profiles, not only by eye.** On S1's far fields two recorded bank lines sat 8-17 px off their strokes and five lines were missing; under willow shoots the eye picks the wrong one. Average the darkness along the proposed line and along parallel lines 2-16 px either side (a 20-line script): a real stroke is darkest at offset 0, a misplaced line is darkest at an offset, and a line that is not there gives a flat profile. It also settles where a line ends (run it in 40 px segments).

**A trunk is a pair of minima.** In a column darkness profile across a grove, an outlined stem shows as two minima 8-10 px apart that stay together from band to band down the silk; single minima that drift are whips or twigs. Count trunk feet this way where crowns tangle (S1's 菜地: 13 trunks and one faint fourteenth, against '25-35 plants' by eye).

**When two tiles each name the same strokes in a note and leave them to the other, a second pass finds an unrecorded thing there.** On S1 both t1 and t2 named the fans at the top edge above the chase field and neither mapped them: they are a small far tree. Search every 'left to' and 'not used' note for strokes that both neighbours mention.
